title: Charagh
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term Charagh which means a lamp. He says every poet has used the term lamp in different contexts such as lamp as light in darkness, lamp as a guide, lamp as a son, etc.

title: Ghar
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the difference between the terms house & home, he says house is just a structure where one can find shelter while home is where people reside together in love & harmony.

title: Kahaaniyat
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term "Kahaaniyat" which means a story; he says every incident in our life whether good or bad becomes a story of our lives & this story we tend to remember throughout our lives.

title: Sadhu
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about sadhu being used as a metaphor to describe a positive human. He says a person must be simple & strong internally & externally just like a sadhu to deal with various challenges in life.

title: Khwaab
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of dreaming. He says you may dream to have a good life, a successful career, a family, a house, etc. but a dream results in success only when put to action.

title: Parindey
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about birds being used as a metaphor to represent humans. The expression of birds flying in the sky is generally used to symbolise success, ambitions, carefreeness, prosperity & abundance.

title: Urdu / Sarsari
desc: Javed Akhtar says shayars earlier had a good control on their speech, dialect, pronunciations & we must incorporate this quality in our speaking to make it more effective.

title: Baat
desc: Javed Akhtar says it is extremely important to have a nice talk.

title: Lafz
desc: Javed Akhtar says words are not just those included in dictionaries but more than that. He says words should be mindfully uttered especially during fights, as they can at times harm relationships.

title: Dostee
desc: Javed Akhtar says in life we can't choose our relatives, but we can definitely choose our friends. He says the bond of friendship sometimes proves to be stronger than all our other bonds.

title: Dosti
desc: Javed Akhtar sometimes says we are so lost in our world that we are clueless about the struggles.

title: Raqeeb
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Raqeeb whom he refers to as a villain in a love story.

title: Ibtedaaye Ishq
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the term *Ibtedaaye Ishq* which means beginning of love.
